meanings.en: to date, to go out (with someone)
meanings.note: Prefix 'вс-' ('up') marks upward or sudden onset of action (stem 'тречаться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'are dating', paired with 'встретиться'.

examples.text: Мы встречаемся уже месяц.
examples.trans: We've been dating for a month.

examples.text: Мы часто встречаемся.
examples.trans: We meet often.

examples.text: Мы уже месяц встречаемся.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'what, that', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.
